prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker—it depends on your needs and which side of the Kansas–Missouri line you live on. For an individual or family plan, **BBS Insurance** looks like a reasonable local option to contact: it says it compares Marketplace and private plans, serves both sides of the metro, and has offices in North Kansas City and Overland Park. Its listed number is **816-205-4664**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker is licensed in your state, which insurers and plans they can actually compare, and whether your doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals are in-network. Also ask them to compare your **after-subsidy premium and total likely costs**, not just the monthly premium. Broker help is often free to you, but confirm that directly.

If you’d rather get unbiased, no-cost enrollment help, Kansas residents can contact a certified navigator through [Kansas CARES](https://thrivekansas.org/kansas-cares/).
